correctness.rationale: Equation (11) of the primary source gives the exact shift formula. Its Fourier multiplier is computed explicitly; the even/odd factorizations and bad-approximability inequalities give |m_n| >= 2*kappa*eta_alpha/(n*sin(alpha)) for every n>=2. Parseval proves the estimate. Convergent denominators give multipliers O(1/n), and the test support functions have p+p'' >= R/2, proving sharpness within smooth strictly convex bodies.
